newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan issues tender to buy November jet fuel.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan issues tender to buy November jet fuel.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy jet fuel for delivery in November, a company official said on Tuesday.
The tenders seek 32,000 tonnes of jet fuel for arrival on Nov 1-30. The tender closes on October 7 and offers are valid to October 9.
Unlike its previous tender, CPC did not give sellers an option to offer on a floating basis.
CPC bought two jet fuel cargoes for arrival in October, one more than its usual, following an unexpected shutdown of one of its crude units at the Taoyuan refinery.
The 100,000-barrel-per-day crude unit has been shutdown since September 14-15 due to the closure of the refinery's crude offloading pipelines due to oil leaks.
CPC paid US$244.80 and $247.82 per tonne for the two jet fuel cargoes on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Keelung or Shen Ao for October 1-31 arrival.
